summary: Straight-line setup routine that first runs a short computation, sets a boolean flag true, then performs a virtual call through the vtable of the object stored in dword_7CD8C0 using slot +28 with argument 13. If that virtual call returns a non-null pointer, the returned object is name-compared against the `this` argument. Always returns 0.

operations.description: Call ShortComputation_fec0() with no arguments; its result is discarded.
Call BooleanFlagSetterVirtualCall(1), setting a boolean flag to true.
Indirect __thiscall dispatch: dereference global dword_7CD8C0 to reach its vtable, load the function pointer at vtable slot +28, and call it with (dword_7CD8C0, 13) as (this, argument).
Guard on the result of the virtual call: if the returned pointer v2 is non-null, proceed to compare it; otherwise skip the comparison.
Call ObjectNameComparison(v2, this), comparing the name of the object returned by the virtual dispatch against the `this` argument.
Return constant 0 regardless of the branch taken.

unresolved: What subsystem index 13 and vtable slot +28 dispatch to is unknown here.
dword_7CD8C0 is an unnamed singleton/manager object; its identity and the semantics of the slot +28 virtual are unproven.
Purpose of ShortComputation_fec0 and which boolean BooleanFlagSetterVirtualCall(1) sets are not evident from this function alone.
